business_problem: LTM’s growth to 87,000 employees across 47 countries created siloed HR and IT workflows plus fragmented AI governance that could not scale with the business.
solution_summary: LTM’s growth to 87,000 employees across 47 countries created siloed HR and IT workflows plus fragmented AI governance that could not scale with the business. LTM implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around AI Control Tower, Now Assist, IT Service Management, and HR Service Delivery. Key components included AI Control Tower governs AI inventory and ROI; Now Assist adds generative search, summarization, and drafting; IT Service Management standardizes incidents and requests; HR Service Delivery manages HR cases and onboarding. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, is classified or summarized by Now Assist before AI Control Tower, IT Service Management, HR Service Delivery, and App Engine routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform. Running employee support and operational workflows on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier.

solution_components.name: AI Control Tower
solution_components.role: Provides centralized AI governance, inventory, and ROI tracking across use cases.

solution_components.name: Now Assist
solution_components.role: Adds generative-AI capabilities such as summarization, drafting, search, and guided responses inside workflows.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Standardizes incident, request, and fulfillment workflows on the platform.

solution_components.name: HR Service Delivery
solution_components.role: Moves HR cases, onboarding, and employee support workflows onto the same platform.

solution_components.name: App Engine
solution_components.role: Supports custom workflow and application development for business processes.
